quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY3/2027 (three months ended June 30, 2026) consolidated results: net sales 93,897 million yen, +10.7% YoY; operating profit 4,818 million yen, +53.3%; ordinary profit 4,263 million yen; profit attributable to owners of parent 2,504 million yen versus a loss of 876 million yen a year earlier - primarily on higher sales in IT infrastructure/industrial equipment and foreign exchange. Capacitors (MLCCs etc.) 69,022 million yen, +14.7% YoY (information, communication and IT infrastructure/industrial equipment up); inductors 15,934 million yen, +7.4%; Others 8,941 million yen, -8.5% (communications devices down). Company says it is continuously expanding capacity to meet increasing demand.
